But cp also has same restrictions: "If the destination is a directory, the source file or directory will be copied into the destination directory. Both source and destination must be local to the current directory." So cp can copy into a directory. So we can do cp('final_report.pdf','temp'), then rm('final_report.pdf'). That would effectively move.

Alternatively, we might use rmdir? No.

Thus steps: mkdir('temp'), cp('final_report.pdf','temp'), rm('final_report.pdf').
